answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Reaching the reef of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. A vine of per-task receipts records who did what, and the voyage of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
